hero.title: About Our Training
hero.subtitle: Practical AI Cybersecurity Training for Modern Professionals
hero.description: At AIKavach, our mission is to help professionals develop practical skills to secure modern AI systems. We deliver instructor-led training that combines technical expertise with real-world experience, enabling participants to understand, assess, and protect AI-powered applications used in today's enterprises.

overview.title: Who We Train
overview.description: Our programs are designed for security professionals, software engineers, cloud architects, AI developers, penetration testers, auditors, and enterprise teams seeking to strengthen their AI security capabilities.

program.title: OSAI – Offensive Security AI Training
program.description: Our flagship OSAI (Offensive Security AI) program focuses on securing Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and enterprise AI platforms through practical, instructor-led learning.
outcomes: Analyze AI application architectures and identify security risks.
Perform AI security assessments using structured methodologies.
Understand AI attack techniques and their business impact.
Implement practical security controls for AI-powered applications.
Apply industry best practices to secure enterprise AI environments.

handsOnTraining.title: Hands-On Learning Experience
handsOnTraining.description: Every training program includes guided laboratory exercises where participants build, configure, test, and secure enterprise AI environments using realistic attack and defense scenarios.
labs: Configure LLMs, AI agents, RAG applications, and supporting infrastructure.
Execute realistic AI attack simulations in a safe lab environment.
Apply defensive techniques to strengthen AI systems.

delivery.title: Weekend Live Training
delivery.description: Our instructor-led weekend sessions are designed specifically for working professionals, allowing participants to learn practical AI cybersecurity skills without interrupting their regular work schedule.

whyChooseUs.title: Why Choose AIKavach
features: LLM, RAG, MCP, and AI Agent security training.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: At AIKavach, we focus on developing practical AI cybersecurity skills that professionals can immediately apply within their organizations. Through structured training, realistic enterprise labs, and expert guidance, we prepare learners to confidently assess, secure, and defend modern AI systems.
